partners.mechanism_chain: BMP15 (HGNC:1421) —DISRUPTS→ Ovarian follicle development (GO:0008281); Ovarian follicle development (GO:0008281) —LEADS_TO→ Ovarian dysgenesis (HP:0000026); APOE (HGNC:507) —DISRUPTS→ Lipid metabolism and transport (GO:0006629); Lipid metabolism and transport (GO:0006629) —LEADS_TO→ Accumulation of undegraded lipids/lipofuscin (CHEBI:77399); Accumulation of undegraded lipids/lipofuscin (CHEBI:77399) —LEADS_TO→ Sea-blue histiocytes (HP:0030176). partners.mechanism_chain: BMP15 (HGNC:1490) —DISRUPTS→ oocyte maturation and follicle development (GO:0001566); oocyte maturation and follicle development (GO:0001566) —LEADS_TO→ ovarian dysgenesis (HP:0000149); TNC (HGNC:11752) —DISRUPTS→ neuronal development and cell adhesion in the inner ear (GO:0007411); neuronal development and cell adhesion in the inner ear (GO:0007411) —LEADS_TO→ nonsyndromic hearing loss (HP:0000405).
